> @copilot 检查所有的问题，包括每一个控件的细节

Deep audit completed in `aec77d0`. Found and fixed 3 additional issues beyond the original commit:

**plugin-list/index.tsx** — `list-view` and `list` registrations had invalid `viewType` enum values (`'list'`, `'chart'` are not valid spec types). Replaced with full spec-compliant set: `grid | kanban | gallery | calendar | timeline | gantt | map`.

**plugin-detail/index.tsx** — `detail-view` registration was missing 8 inputs that exist on `DetailViewSchema`: `layout`, `columns`, `loading`, `backUrl`, `editUrl`, `deleteConfirmation`, `header`, `footer`.

**plugin-detail/index.tsx** — `detail-section` registration was missing `showBorder` and `headerColor` inputs (already implemented in `DetailSection.tsx` component and TS interface).

All 2015 tests pass (898 view-related + 1117 compliance).
